items.title: Incyte (INCY) Nears New ESMO Data For KRAS G12D Candidate 734
items.summary: Incyte (NasdaqGS: INCY) is drawing attention as its KRAS G12D inhibitor '734 heads into new data presentations at ESMO, focused on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The upcoming ESMO readout is expected to support ongoing Phase 3 trials of '734 in pancreatic cancer, a disease area with high unmet medical need. items.title: Incyte Corporation (INCY) has the Bigger Revenue Base, but Could Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (HALO) have the Better Economics?
items.summary: On July 20, Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:HALO) and Incyte Corporation (NASDAQ:INCY) announced a global collaboration and licensing deal to develop a subcutaneous formulation of Incyte’s INCA033989. The first-in-class monoclonal antibody targets mutant calreticulin (mutCALR)-expressing myeloproliferative neoplasms.
